summary: Improve farmer-group governance, member services and market planning. Explore practical training and build usable organizational tools.
lede: Farmer organization development training helps cooperative officers, producer-group leaders and agricultural programme staff turn member priorities into workable governance and services. Participants assess group readiness, apply ICA Cooperative Principles, clarify decision rights, build Excel member registers and cash-flow forecasts, prioritize services, and plan collective marketing. Exercises also cover value-chain mapping and progress tracking against staff and budget capacity.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who establish, govern or support farmer-led groups and need practical ways to connect member priorities with workable systems.
modules: Participatory Rural Appraisal for Group Readiness
Excel Member Registry and Data Stewardship
RACI Decision Rights for Farmer Organizations
Theory of Change for Member Services
prerequisites: This intermediate course suits you if you have experience supporting farmer groups, cooperatives or producer organizations. Working familiarity with spreadsheets is useful; coding is not required.
